name: Pos Malaysia Run 2026
short_description: Pos Malaysia Run 2026 is a half-marathon held on November 29, 2026, at Dataran Merdeka, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
ai_summary: Pos Malaysia Run 2026 is a half-marathon event taking place on November 29, 2026, at Dataran Merdeka in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. Organised by Pos Malaysia, the race offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5.5km. Individual entry fees range from MYR 68 to MYR 138 depending on the distance and entry period.
pros: Race kits posted to your home, with postage and insurance included in the fee
A central Kuala Lumpur course that started and finished at Stadium Merdeka in 2025
Options for families, relay pairs and runners with disabilities
Medals made from recycled zip ties, and reusable cups at the event
A first 21 km added for 2026, with cash prizes five deep
cons: A fast front: the 2025 10 km was won in 27:56 and 31:34
Humid: 26°C and 94% humidity at the 2025 start
A rolling city course rather than a flat one
The 21 km is new in 2026, so there is no past edition to judge it by

faqs.question: What distance options are available at Pos Malaysia Run 2026?
faqs.answer: Pos Malaysia Run 2026 offers three distance categories for participants to choose from: a 21.1km half-marathon, a 10km run, and a shorter 5.5km run. This range allows both experienced runners and beginners or casual participants to find a distance suited to their fitness level and goals.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to register for Pos Malaysia Run 2026?
faqs.answer: Registration fees depend on the distance selected. The 21.1km half-marathon costs between MYR 118 and 138, the 10km run costs MYR 88 to 108, and the 5.5km run costs MYR 68 to 88. Prices vary within each category depending on registration timing or tier.

faqs.question: Who organises Pos Malaysia Run 2026?
faqs.answer: Pos Malaysia Run 2026 is organised by Pos Malaysia Berhad, and the 29 November race is its third edition. The 2025 edition was sanctioned by the Federal Territory Athletics Association and supported by the traffic investigation police and Kuala Lumpur City Hall (DBKL). The 2026 race adds a 21 km category for the first time.

faqs.question: Where and when is Pos Malaysia Run 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The race is on Sunday 29 November 2026, starting from Dataran Merdeka in Kuala Lumpur, with an event window of 4am to 12pm. Runners choose from 21.1 km, 10 km or 5.5 km. The 2025 edition started and finished at Stadium Merdeka instead, so its course is not a guide to the 2026 route.
